NDT software in Long Beach: port, marine, offshore and new-space inspection

NDT software in Long Beach has to keep up with one of the most varied inspection markets on the West Coast. In a few square miles you have container terminals and cranes at the Port of Long Beach, vessels calling at the San Pedro Bay complex that also includes the Port of Los Angeles, oil production from the Wilmington field and the offshore THUMS islands, tank terminals and pipelines, and a fast-growing space manufacturing cluster around Long Beach Airport. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Long Beach NDT company one system for certifications, calibration, dispatch, marine and industrial reports, quoting and invoicing.

The space side is recent and real. Rocket Lab moved its headquarters to Long Beach and builds Electron hardware there, and Relativity Space is headquartered in the city with a large factory on the former Boeing C-17 site. Their suppliers bring machining, welding, additive manufacturing and composite work that needs PT, UT, RT and ET inspection documented to aerospace expectations. At the harbour, terminal operators, crane owners, shipping lines and ship repairers need weld and structural inspection on cranes, hatch covers, hull steel and piping, much of it under the eye of a classification society surveyor. And the oil operations and nearby Wilmington and Carson refineries keep UT, PAUT, RT and MT crews busy on piping, vessels and tanks.

A typical Long Beach NDT contractor is a field company of five to forty technicians that works across at least two of these sectors, with a small office handling scheduling, reports and billing. Cal/OSHA sets workplace safety rules, the U.S. Coast Guard and classification societies shape marine work, and port tenants run their own contractor safety programs. The ERP does not manage that compliance; it keeps the records that prove each inspection was done by a qualified person, with calibrated equipment, to an approved procedure.

ERP for NDT companies in Long Beach: one database across sectors

An ERP for NDT companies in Long Beach needs to handle a class-witnessed weld repair on a ship, a crane boom inspection and a machined rocket component without three different systems. The Atlantis ERP is configured per company during implementation, so each sector gets its own report templates and numbering while people, instruments and billing stay in one place.

For a mixed contractor, that single database solves a daily problem: the same Level II UT technician may be needed on a vessel in the morning and at a terminal in the afternoon. The system knows their certifications, vision test and availability, knows which flaw detector is calibrated and free, and puts both on the job without clashes. Reports reference work order, request, WPS, contract and drawing numbers plus procedure and standard, so marine, industrial and aerospace clients each get the references they expect. The core apps for Long Beach are NDT Reports (with marine mode), Certificates, Procedures, Team Assignments, Asset Management, Fleet, Quotations and Invoicing. The full list is on the ERP apps overview.

NDT reporting software with marine mode for San Pedro Bay vessel work

NDT reporting software for Long Beach marine work should produce the pack a surveyor expects without an evening of PDF merging. The Atlantis NDT Reports app has a marine mode that adds a vessel cover page and photo, inspection location and dates, and merges the classification-society certificate, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF.

The class library covers DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, RINA, IRS and ClassNK, and inspection photos lay out in a 2-up grid. That matters when a vessel is in berth for a short window and the surveyor wants the UT or MT report before sign-off. Across all work the app has 17 report types, including UT with probe calibration table, RT with source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws, TOFD, MFL scan mode, UT thickness by direction, PMI, hardness, ferrite and holiday/coating tests. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and results are acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports flow draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer, approver and third-party or authorized inspector signatures. The offline field app handles poor signal inside hulls, tank interiors and crane machinery houses, syncing when the technician is back on deck. See NDT Reports.

Technician certification tracking software for mixed marine and industrial crews

Technician certification tracking software in Long Beach often has to hold certificates from more than one scheme, because foreign-flag vessel owners and international class societies may ask for ISO 9712 or PCN evidence alongside SNT-TC-1A employer certification. The Atlantis Certificates app records SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes side by side.

Each certificate stores level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam results and the file itself. Status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked, with warnings 90 days ahead. Vision tests are recorded with Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry. The employee NDT profile adds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry.

Because marine mode merges the inspector's Level II certificate into the report PDF, keeping certificates current in the ERP directly affects what the surveyor sees. Daily checks raise warning tasks, configurable email alerts reach your Level III and office manager, and Timesheets warns when a technician books hours while their certificate is not valid. See Certificates.

Calibration management software for harbour-side equipment

Calibration management software near the water has to deal with salt air, dropped probes and equipment that moves between ships, terminals and plants every day. The Atlantis Asset Management app tracks each instrument by serial number, with condition recorded at issue and return and calibration status visible at dispatch.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass/fail/conditional result and next due date. The certificate register stores lab accreditation number and PDF, flags expiring and expired certificates and sends alerts, and it is that certificate which marine mode merges into the report pack. Lifecycle states cover new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired and disposed, and rental rates can be recorded when you hire kit to or from another company, which is common when a large vessel job needs more PAUT units than you own.

The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work with condition before and after, useful for yokes and probes that see a lot of corrosion exposure. Consumables such as couplant, particles, penetrant and PPE carry reorder levels and a movement ledger. See Asset Management.

Crew dispatch software for vessel windows and terminal shutdowns

Crew dispatch software in Long Beach lives or dies on short windows: a ship alongside for a day, a crane out of service over a weekend, a tank terminal line isolated for one shift. Atlantis Team Assignments moves each job through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, and blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers.

Jobs store site GPS coordinates, which is handy for a specific berth or island rather than a postal address, and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps, and Time Off feeds it. Technicians show utilisation, current assignment and next available date. When assigned equipment is out of calibration, the dispatcher gets a warning before the crew leaves. The Project app holds client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria and the safety induction and work permit fields that terminal and port security processes demand. Fleet records vehicle assignments with dates and mileage and flags which vehicles can carry radioactive sources with their transport licence details. See Team Assignments and Fleet.

Supporting Long Beach aerospace and space suppliers

Aerospace and space suppliers in Long Beach expect documented procedures and traceable records on every part. The Atlantis Procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard and acceptance criteria, and moves each procedure through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published.

Approved revisions are locked, every revision is kept as a snapshot and rejections carry a reason, so you can show exactly what was in force when a lot was inspected. An AI-assisted first draft helps a Level III start a new procedure, which the Level III then reviews and approves. Company certifications such as ISO 9001 and customer approvals are tracked with alert days. For clients that want inspection data on a model rather than a spreadsheet, Digital Twin Reporting Software and Atlantis Digital Twins map indications onto 3D geometry. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for port and vessel clients

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Long Beach has to bill shipping agents, terminal operators, refiners and manufacturers who all want different paperwork. Atlantis Quotations produces branded quote PDFs with job type, site, dates, applicable codes and NDT service products by method, supports online acceptance and signature, and converts to a sales order.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup hours with billable flag and rate multiplier, so waiting on a vessel's hot work permit or a crane lockout is captured. Invoices carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals, and lines show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Expenses covers parking, port access costs and per diems re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard tracks revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices, which matters when some foreign owners pay slowly. See Invoicing.

Inspection management software in Long Beach: CRM for a mixed customer base

Inspection management software should help you balance marine, energy and aerospace work rather than chase whoever called last. The Atlantis CRM tags leads by service line, NDT service type and industry sector, estimates technicians and days, and scores each lead from 0 to 100 as hot, warm, nurture or cold.

Import ship managers or supplier lists from CSV, photograph business cards from port and maritime events with the Business Cards app, and run drip email sequences per service line. Dashboards show calibration due, certs expiring and equipment overdue for return. See CRM.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Long Beach

An affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Long Beach lets a small firm run marine, industrial and aerospace work without enterprise overhead. Atlantis quotes on request based on the apps and integrations you choose.

Marine-heavy firms usually start with NDT Reports in marine mode, Certificates and Asset Management; plant-heavy firms add Team Assignments and Timesheets. The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Ask for a Long Beach quote.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Long Beach

Implementation is run remotely by Atlantis NDT, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III. A practical order for a Long Beach contractor:

  1. Certificates and vision tests for every technician, because marine reports embed them.
  2. Instruments and calibration certificates by serial number, with accredited-lab details.
  3. Marine and industrial templates, including the class societies you work with most.
  4. Dispatch and Fleet, with berths, terminals and plants as sites.
  5. Quotations, Timesheets and Invoicing, with standby and multiplier rules.
  6. Field rollout of the offline app on live jobs.

Atlantis also offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, an eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator for developing trainees. Discuss your rollout.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT software for small NDT companies doing ship work in Long Beach?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP includes a marine mode for NDT reports and is configured for small and mid-sized contractors, with pricing quoted on request.

Which classification societies are in the marine library?

DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, RINA, IRS and ClassNK.

Can it track instruments we rent in for big jobs?

Yes. Items can be set to rented out, rental rates can be recorded and calibration is tracked per serial number.

Does it plan a terminal or refinery owner's inspection programme?

No. The ERP runs your inspection business and records report data; programme planning and engineering assessment stay with the owner. API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services are available separately through inspection services.

Will it work alongside our accounting software?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

Do you provide technician training?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training only. The ERP can record other certificates your technicians hold, such as ISO 9712 or PCN.
